feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 27 May 2026 4:35pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 27 May 2026 at 4:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure is centred in the North Sea.


##Wind##

East 4 or 5, increasing east or southeast 5 or 6 later in the evening, gradually easing southeast 3 or 4, occasionally 5 by the end of tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the south of the area, becoming mainly moderate for a time tonight and early tomorrow, then mostly slight by the afternoon.


##Weather##

Scattered showers later this evening and tonight, then mainly fair tomorrow, but some coastal mist later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers overnight, becoming poor in mist later tomorrow.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast 3 or 4, imminently veering south or southwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 later in the night into Friday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, soon become mainly moderate in the evening, then slight or moderate on Friday.


##Weather##

Mist and fog patches for a time, soon becoming mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor or very poor in mist and fog patches.
